name: llm-4
title: LLM daily set: 4 scenarios that fit the free-tier Gemini quota
description: Four contrasting MVP scenarios (a plain delay, a carrier API timeout, a refund demand that needs escalation, and an ambiguous complaint). About 16 Gemini requests, so one run fits the free tier's 20 requests per day and the default cap of 4 LLM runs.
